title: L-side identity equations for the integral finite-extension comparison
statement: For fixed L, dualizing datum wL and normalized tensor presentation b satisfying first-variable evaluation naturality, the prescribed identity-extension maps satisfy IdentityConclusion for L [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core].

proof.text: Repeat the finite counit-transpose calculation for coefficient field L. Coherent total limits and the uniqueness characterization identify the resulting u map with the prescribed identity unit.

Apply the evaluation transpose and internal-Hom naturality to obtain the v and beta identity equations for b. Multiplication and the fixed representative normalization cover identity fields, zero objects and empty schemes.

theorem comparison_identity_L
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (wL : DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (b : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
    (_hevalL : ∀ (K K' M : IntegralVerdier.Ambient l L X) (f : K' ⟶ K),
      b.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
          ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X)).map
            (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 M)))) ≫ (b.adjunction K').counit.app M =
        b.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (b.adjunction K).counit.app M) :
    IdentityConclusion l L X D hl wL b
